The '''Changing of the Imperial Guard''' was a formal ceremony conducted by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which entailed changing shifts amongst several members of the guard. Observing at least one of these shifts was part of the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]{{'s}} [[Grand Galactic Tour]].<ref name="RPG" />
